_comment: Phase 9 first content: the Paladin Aura combination. Secret — never documented in-game. Curated per the design; Damage and Heal at the levels below unlock it. ⚑ NUMBERS REWRITE C2a: ingredient levels are ABSOLUTE and did NOT move with the cap pass (PO 2026-07-31), so an ingredient named at 5 whose cap is now 10 unlocks this half-way up its curve rather than at its ceiling. Re-pointing them at the new caps was rejected — two maxed cap-10 skills cost 32 points against a 29-point level-30 budget, which would make the recipe unreachable.
